messages.subject: Webinar: Whistleblowing detriment after recent EAT decisions (CPD 1.5 hrs)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Member,

Join our panel for a 90-minute update on recent developments in whistleblowing detriment and the burden of proof, with 1.5 CPD hours. Thursday 27 February, 12:30pm, online. Members £35. Click to reserve your place.

Employment Lawyers Association
